dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The people here don't seem to be the type to pay up honestly.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: I thought the same way at first. But in reality, our rate of reimbursement is higher than even Fontaine's branches.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because I tell our clients that the Northland Bank will provide "suitable" jobs to those who can't pay off their debts, to help them return to their normal lives as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Hehe, maybe it's magic? After hearing that spiel, the at-risk clients always, always end up settling their debts in just a few days.
